description: Abstract class for endpoint results in the OrangeHRM Core API v2 serializer, handling normalization, metadata, and relationship data.

classes.name: AbstractEndpointResult
classes.description: An abstract class implementing EndpointResult, responsible for normalizing endpoint result data, managing metadata, and relationships.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model class, data, and optional metadata and relationships, throwing exception if class not found.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Abstract method for normalizing the result data into an array format.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns the metadata ParameterBag, if any.

methods.name: getRels
methods.description: Returns the relationships ParameterBag, if any.
